# Matthew Cuthbert

## Appearance

An odd-looking man, he possesses an ungainly figure characterized by stooping shoulders. His long, iron-gray hair reaches down to his shoulders, and he has kept a full, soft brown beard since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Extremely shy and reticent, Matthew Cuthbert is a naturally silent man who rarely speaks, often frustrating others by staying uncommunicative rather than engaging in argument. Despite his quiet demeanor, he is deeply persistent, stubborn in holding fast to his opinions, and known to be hardworking, patient, and wise. He harbors a profound fear and dread of women and little girls, dreading strangers so severely that even a new minister's wife frightens him, and he occasionally smokes when his mind is perturbed. In his daily routine, he avoids excitement, sticking mostly to his kitchen and bedroom to remain undisturbed. Nevertheless, he is a good-natured and sympathetic listener who shows great love and gentleness, notably forming a strong desire to keep [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

## History

Matthew Cuthbert, who had worn a full brown beard since age twenty, lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with his sister [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When he traveled to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station expecting to retrieve an orphan boy to help on the farm, he instead found [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) waiting. Rather than corrected the mistake on the spot, Matthew brought her home and gently advocated for keeping her. He quietly supported [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she settled into the household, secretly comforting her during a period of punishment and slipping her a package of chocolates. Recognizing her desire to look like her peers, Matthew secretly coordinated with Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to present [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with a stylish dress for a local [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert, where he watched her perform with immense pride. He and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) subsequently agreed to pay for Anne's advanced studies to prepare her for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, and Matthew warmly expressed his proud affection for her upon her return from Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) as an Avery Scholarship winner. The following morning, after reading a newspaper article detailing the failure of the Abbey Bank, Matthew suffered a fatal collapse and died, leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to grieve his sudden passing.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Matthew forms an immediate, soft-hearted attachment to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) upon bringing her to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), becoming her earliest champion. He quietly lobbies a reluctant [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to keep the girl and later sneaks to Anne's room to gently persuade her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), helping end her punishment. Their affectionate bond is marked by silent understanding and tender gestures, such as Matthew bringing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a sweet treat to show his care.

- Friend of — best of friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>
